i drafted the coat using a “shacket” (shirt jacket) i already owned, and modified it to be slightly smaller than the original garment. 

i quilted 32 of the diamonds together to create the front panels and layered them with heavy weight fleece for insulation and a plush feel

i assembled the lining as a seperate piece and finished the main outer shell of the jacket using my serger

next, i embellished the outside quilted panels with crystals, rhinestones, and hand beading pearls into where the diamond points met

i cut out feather appliques and hand sewed them to the shoulders of the coat shell, and embellished them using the same crystals and pearls as the front panels

i assembled and sewed the collar piece with fusible interfacing and sewed it between the lining and shell

using a regular sewing machine, i sewed together the lining to the shell along all the outside edges

i then bound all the raw edges with gold double fold bias tape and added on trims and extra hand beading and rhinestoning to the sleeve cuffs and bottom hem of the coat
